import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static int INF = 1000000000;
    static int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n, t;
    static int[][] cap = new int[400][400];
    static int[][] shortest = new int[15][15][15][15];
    static char[][] scien = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] reac = new char[20][20];
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int iter = 3;
    static int[] vis = new int[400];

    static int getnode(int x, int y) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y - 1;
    }

    static int reach[][] = new int[13][13];
    static int treach[][] = new int[13][13];

    static boolean canreach(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int ix, int iy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 13; j++) {
                reach[i][j] = 0;
                treach[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }
        reach[sx][sy] = 1;
        reach[ix][iy] = 2;
        int iters = 100;
        while (iters-- > 0) {
            expand(1);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 1) {
                return true;
            }
            expand(2);
            if (reach[tx][ty] == 2) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void expand(int val) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                treach[i][j] = reach[i][j];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (treach[i][j] == val) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                        int ni = i + dx[k];
                        int nj = j + dy[k];
                        if (ni > 0 && nj > 0 && ni <= n && nj <= n && treach[ni][nj] < val && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            reach[ni][nj] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int aug(int cnode, int dest, int bneck) {
        if (cnode == dest) {
            return bneck;
        }
        if (vis[cnode] == iter) {
            return 0;
        }
        vis[cnode] = iter;
        for (int i = 0; i <= dest; i++) {
            int cret = 0;
            if (cap[cnode][i] > 0 && (cret = aug(i, dest, Math.min(bneck, cap[cnode][i]))) > 0) {
                cap[cnode][i] -= cret;
                cap[i][cnode] += cret;
                return cret;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            scien[i] = st.nextToken().toCharArray();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                shortest[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                if (scien[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    int infx = i;
                    int infy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            reac[i] = st.nextToken().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k];
                    int nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni <= n && ni > 0 && nj <= n && nj > 0) {
                        if (scien[i][j] != 'Y' && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y')
                            shortest[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
            for (int kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
                for (int ii = 1; ii <= n; ii++) {
                    for (int ij = 1; ij <= n; ij++) {
                        for (int ji = 1; ji <= n; ji++) {
                            for (int jj = 1; jj <= n; jj++) {
                                shortest[ii][ij][ji][jj] = Math.min(shortest[ii][ij][ji][jj], shortest[ii][ij][ki][kj] + shortest[ki][kj][ji][jj]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int src = n * n * 2 + 1;
        int dest = n * n * 2 + 2;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(scien[i][j])) {
                    cap[src][getnode(i, j)] = scien[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(reac[i][j])) {
                    cap[n * n + getnode(i, j)][dest] = reac[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(scien[i][j])) {
                    for (int ki = 1; ki <= n; ki++) {
                        for (int kj = 1; kj <= n; kj++) {
                            if (Character.isDigit(reac[ki][kj]) && shortest[i][j][ki][kj] <= t && canreach(i, j, ki, kj, 1, 1)) {
                                cap[getnode(i, j)][n * n + getnode(ki, kj)] = 1000;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int mflow = 0;
        while (aug(src, dest, 1000) > 0) {
            mflow += aug(src, dest, 1000);
            iter++;
        }
        pw.println(mflow);
        pw.close();
    }
}
